items.title: European Commission Confirms Cyberattack Following AWS Account Hack
items.description: The European Commission has officially confirmed a cyberattack following a targeted cyberattack that compromised its Amazon Web Services (AWS) account. Discovered on March 24, the intrusion specifically affected the external cloud environment that hosts the Commission’s public web presence on the Europa.eu platform. items.title: Windows 11 and Server 2025 Update to Block Untrusted Cross-Signed Kernel Drivers by Default
items.description: Microsoft is taking a major step to harden the Windows operating system against kernel-level threats by removing trust for drivers signed by the deprecated cross-signed root program. Starting with the April 2026 update, Windows 11 and Windows Server 2025 will block these untrusted drivers by default. items.title: CISA Adds Aquasecurity Trivy Scanner Vulnerability to KEV Catalog
items.description: CISA has officially added a critical vulnerability affecting Aquasecurity’s Trivy scanner to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. Tracked as CVE-2026-33634, this alarming security flaw poses a severe risk to software development pipelines.
